{{Quote|All this excitement has overrun the circuits of my counterpart here. If you don't mind, I like to take him down to maintenance.''"<br />"''Alright.|C-3PO speaking to the stormtrooper|<ref name="ANH" />}}
Stationed onboard the [[Death Star/Legends|''Death Star'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]], this '''[[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]''' was part of a patrol that was sent to investigate a security alert from [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]] commanded by [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Pol Treidum/Legends|Pol Treidum]]. After unlocking the doors and finding the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who claimed that the rebels imprisoned them inside the storage compartment, this stormtrooper was assigned to stay and guard the control room, and also ultimately allowed C-3PO and R2-D2 to leave under the pretense that the latter needed to be brought to maintenance due to its circuits being "overrun."<ref name="ANH" />
